title: Splitting of the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: The split Heavenly Eye reflected the blood-colored finale seven hundred chapters later—Chen Ji saw himself lying in the ruins, with a familiar yet unfamiliar figure standing beside him.

text.content: Dark red patterns spread across the yellowed page like living things. Chen Ji felt a tearing pain in his brow center, as if something was trying to break free from his fontanel. He abruptly opened his eyes, pupils constricting—the world in his vision split into two layers: one was the vast world he knew, the other the primordial chaos from the beginning of creation.

"This is..." Chen Ji gritted his teeth, fingertips digging deep into his palm. He felt his mental sea being torn by an invisible force, a force coming from the depths of the Tianji Record, from a forbidden realm he had never touched. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, no longer the usual composure, but with a rare gravity: "It's bad. He's here."

Before the words finished, the searing pain at Chen Ji's brow center climbed to its peak. He下意识地 reached up to touch his brow center, but his fingertips touched something cold—a pupil forming, bearing a heart-stopping pressure, slowly emerging from his brow center. The Heavenly Eye, the Eye of Heaven's Way, had actually condensed completely on his body.

dialogue.content: "Steady your mind!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rushed out from the first page, his illusory figure blocking Chen Ji, yet unable to stop the third eye's formation, "Once the Heavenly Eye is formed, you can no longer hide. The Eye of Heaven's Way will see everything about you, including everything you shouldn't see!"

text.content: However, Chen Ji could no longer hear Mo Xiansheng's warning. The newly formed Heavenly Eye suddenly opened, the pupil splitting into two in an instant—one half as black as ink, reflecting all of Chen Ji's strategies and layouts throughout these seven hundred chapters; the other half was blood-red, reflecting an entirely different figure, a person Chen Ji had never seen yet somehow intimately knew.

"Who are you?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. He felt his consciousness being invaded by something foreign. It was an extremely powerful mental sea, carrying the same origin yet completely different aura, trying to compete with him for control of this body.

dialogue.content: "Me?" That mental sea let out a hoarse laugh in Chen Ji's mind, a laugh carrying endless vicissitudes and venom, "I am you, Chen Ji. Or rather, I am Chen Tianming—the true inheritor of the Tianji Record, and you are merely a wisp of remnant soul I split off when I fell."

text.content: Chen Tianming's consciousness surged in like a tide. Chen Ji felt his memories being flipped through, being altered. Those past events he thought belonged to him revealed completely different truths at this moment—he was never any trash making a comeback; he was merely another person's shadow, a vessel bearing the obsession of revenge.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's consciousness coiled around like a venomous snake, eroding Chen Ji's mental sea foundation. At this critical moment, he must make a choice—

choices.description: Forcefully suppress Chen Tianming's consciousness with Heavenly Fate, the cost being consumption of one's own luck
choices.risk_hint: May cause mental sea damage, temporary decrease in Combat Power

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth tightly. The remaining Heavenly Fate in his body burned wildly at this moment. The foreign consciousness eroding his mental sea let out a furious roar, but was forced back by the blazing luck. His vision returned to clarity, but the newly formed Heavenly Eye became even more unstable from this turmoil.

choices.description: Accept Chen Tianming's memories and power, completing the true Tianji Record inheritance
choices.risk_hint: May lead to personality changes, being replaced by Chen Tianming

text.content: Chen Ji did not resist, letting that consciousness merge into the depths of his mental sea. In an instant, countless memories not belonging to him flooded in like a deluge—Chen Tianming's millennia of schemes, his meticulously set eternal chess game. A slight smile appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth; he finally understood his true purpose for existence.

choices.description: Coexist with Chen Tianming's consciousness, constructing a balanced state of dual personality
choices.visible_reward: Possess the strategies of both individuals simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: Balance extremely difficult to maintain, may collapse at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji's mind reached an unprecedented calm at this moment. He did not suppress, nor did he fuse; instead, with an almost cruel理智, he wove the two consciousnesses together by force. Agonizing pain struck, blood seeped from his nose, but those pupils finally stabilized—one half black, one half blood-red, miraculously coexisting peacefully.

dialogue.content: "Well done." Mo Xiansheng's phantom condensed beside Chen Ji, a hint of relief appearing on that aged face, "Maintaining such composure under Heavenly Fate's backlash, you are stronger than I anticipated. However..." His gaze fell on the not-yet-fully-stable Heavenly Eye at Chen Ji's brow center, his voice suddenly heavy, "The Heavenly Eye has already reflected your fated ending."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. He slowly raised his head, concentrating his consciousness on that split Heavenly Eye. The images in the pupils began to flow. He saw ruins, saw the sky filled with blood, saw himself lying on shattered jade—a scene of death, the endpoint of his fate seven hundred chapters later.

dialogue.content: "Seven hundred chapters." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, yet his fists clenched tightly within his sleeves, "I will die at chapter seven hundred?" He raised his head. In those pupils, half black and half blood-red, there was no fear, no despair, only a glint of cold calculation, "Who killed me?"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye turned again, the images becoming clearer. Chen Ji saw himself lying in the ruins, his chest soaked in blood, yet his expression held no pain but a near-peaceful smile. And not far away, a figure stood—the figure's outline was blurred, yet Chen Ji felt an inexplicable, heart-piercing familiarity.

dialogue.content: "You see it?" Chen Tianming's consciousness rang out again in his mind, this time carrying an ineffable emotion, "You, seven hundred chapters later, will die at the hands of someone you trust most. This is the curse of the Tianji Record—you can see everyone's fate, except you cannot change your own ending."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He simply静静地 gazed at that scene of death, at that blurred figure, an odd sensation spreading through his heart. He knew that figure, he definitely knew it. It's just that the Heavenly Eye at this moment was not yet powerful enough to reflect more details, but that sense of familiarity was like a thorn, deeply embedded in his heart.

dialogue.content: "This is the price." Mo Xiansheng's voice interrupted Chen Ji's contemplation. His figure had grown increasingly faint, "The clearer the Heavenly Eye reflects, the greater the consumption of Heavenly Fate. That scene you just saw consumed at least ten years of your lifespan. And more importantly—" He paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes, "You have already attracted the attention of the Heavenly Eye of Heaven's Way."

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head. He felt in the chaotic depths reflected by that Heavenly Eye, an existence beyond all his understanding was slowly awakening. That was the Heavenly Eye of Heaven's Way, the true manifestation of heaven's will. It had no form, no emotion, only absolute karma and reincarnation. And now, it had finally noticed this tiny crawler attempting to peer into fate.

Above the heavens, an invisible pressure descended. Chen Ji felt his entire body grow heavy, as if ten thousand mountains were pressing down simultaneously. That was heaven's gaze, fate's very scrutiny. In this moment, he clearly realized—he had been drawn into a chess game far beyond his imagination, and sitting across from the board was the will of this heaven and earth itself.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile carried a hint of arrogance, yet also absolute composure, "A death trap seven hundred chapters away, the Heavenly Eye of Heaven's Way's attention, and you, the so-called legitimate inheritor..." He slowly rose to his feet. Though the Heavenly Eye at his brow center was not yet fully stable, it was already emanating a might beyond this realm, "All of you want to use me as a chess piece? Then come, let's see who devours whom first."

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil split into two under the excruciating pain—one half reflecting Chen Ji's seven hundred chapters of strategies and layouts, the other half reflecting Chen Tianming's millennia of obsession and grudge. And deep within those twin pupils, a blurred figure stood in the ruins seven hundred chapters later, awaiting this chess game's final conclusion. Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, yet the coldness in his eyes only deepened—fate wanted to kill him? Then he would tear this fate apart with his own hands.
